{{Quote|The fact many astromech droids carry the Intellex IV certainly was a great asset to Alliance operations in the Periphery some time ago: our agent Shaparo was able to take the unit from his companion, R2-Q8, and analyze the prisoner files at the Dnalvec garrison on Sriluur.|[[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]]|<ref name="J10" />}}
The '''Intellex IV''' was a [[Droid brain/Legends|droid brain]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II||Intellex IV}}</ref> and analysis program package.<ref name="J10" /> It was part of the [[Intellex]] series designed and manufactured by [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]]. It was the successor to the [[Intellex III]], and the predecessor to the [[Intellex V/Legends|Intellex V]].<ref name="CSWE" /> The Intellex IV was used in Industrial Automaton's [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]], such as the [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]] and the [[V1 pilot droid]].<ref name="J10" />

A design trademarked by Industrial Automaton, the Intellex IV was capable of performing over 10,000 MPF operations a [[Standard second|second]].<ref name="RPG" /> The computer held an internal [[Starship/Legends|starship]] configuration database that contained seven hundred different vessel designs.<ref name="J7">{{JournalCite|7|The History of R-Series Astromech Droids}}</ref> The Intellex IV scanned technical files in the internal computer to determine potential problems, scan data parameters, or debug computer code.<ref name="RPG" /> The Intellex IV also supported sophisicated analysis programming that allowed for lifeform identification subroutines and other low-level [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] operations.<ref name="J10" /> Information gathered from a droid's [[Droid sensorscope|sensorscope]] was fed into the Intellex IV.<ref name="CCG-D-Sensorscope">{{CCG|set=Dagobah Limited|cardname=Droid Sensorscope}}</ref>

Intellex IVs could be removed from the droids and used independently. When utilized in that manner, the computer could be used to enter restricted-access files and [[Slicer/Legends|slice]] into security systems.<ref name="J10" />

[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] propaganda maintained that the Intellex IV was designed by one of their own [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]]. The propaganda continued until well after the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] when [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Aryn Dro Thul]] discovered the [[R2-0]] prototype.<ref name="CSWE" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Shaparo]] used the Intellex IV from his [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]], [[R2-Q8]], to analyze the [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] files from the [[Dnalvec]] [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sriluur/Legends|Sriluur]]. The information gained allowed the Alliance to rescue captured [[operative]]s.<ref name="J10" />
